description:
Which ready-made model names (recipes, e.g. spideriq/chat) work on YOUR keys, and which key
would unlock the rest. Each recipe lists its slots (provider + model) with a state:
- usable — filled_by own (your key), group (a connected company's key) or pool (the shared free pool).
- locked — no key you can use serves it; `unlock` names the provider and add_url to add one.
- lease_only — a sign-in leased to its own CLI; never serves chat.
- not_routed — a Codex slot outside first place; it is never tried.
A recipe is usable when any slot is. `recommended` is the recipe to give an agent (never agent/*);
it matches recommended_model in gate_onboarding_status. `unlock` (top level) ranks providers by how
many recipes a key would open. Send a usable recipe's name as the model on gate_chat.
Read-only; never returns a key. The brand is your credential's; there is no brand_id here.
name: gate_recipes
